library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)
load(here::here("data", "clean", "clean.Rdata"))


n_eq_g5 <- clean %>% filter(mag>5) %>% count()

min_date <- clean %>% summarize(min=min(ymd_hms(time)))


max_date <- clean %>% summarize(max=max(ymd_hms(time)))

save(n_eq_g5, min_date, max_date, 
     file = "data/clean/number_earthquakes.Rdata")


ggplot(data = clean, aes(x=mag)) + geom_histogram(fill = "lightblue", color = "black")
